pairs.why: The two are almost the same, but A has screws, a seam along the base panel and a soft floor reflection like the vending machine card, so it reads a little more like a built object; B is a slightly blanker, more toy-like shell.
This is the same pair with the sides swapped: B has the screws, panel seam and floor reflection that match how the real cards are built, while A is the plainer, less finished version.
